description: This PHP source file defines the AdminUserAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing admin user data during installation, including both retrieving and creating/updating admin user information. It extends an abstract REST controller and interacts with a state container and request/response objects.

classes.name: AdminUserAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class that handles POST and GET requests to manage administrator user data during the installation process.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to create or update admin user data, validating required fields and storing data in the state container.

methods.name: checkAndGetField
methods.description: Utility method to validate that a specific field exists in the request and is not empty, returning its value or throwing an exception.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve stored admin user data from the state container and return it as a response.
